_source_note: Barbarian is one of the twelve CoA classes that shipped with base stats, armour type, weapon proficiency and a resource but no abilities and no talents, which left it unselectable. Written as a sibling of tools/build_guardian.py and following its structure, helpers and _source discipline.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack. The id matters - combat/abilities.py fires ON_WEAPON_SWING only for '<class>_attack', so Crusher keys off this one.

abilities.name: Ancestral Strike
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Smash and Ancestral Strike as your Energy fillers'. The cheap no-cooldown filler every spec presses, so it carries Warrior heroic_strike's curve exactly.

abilities.name: Whirling Advance
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA class tree builds a whole cluster around it - Dauntless, Rage Whirling, Forward Advance, Whirling Assault - so it is the shared gap-closer. The real one dispels a slow on hit; there is no self-dispel hook on a damage cast, so Dauntless carries mitigation instead.

abilities.name: Barbaric Whirl
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 5 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Barbaric Whirl on any pull of 3+ mobs'. The shared cleave. enemy_aoe rather than the is_aoe flag - is_aoe is not read by _ability_from_data, so target_type is what actually makes an ability hit a pack.

abilities.name: Unbridled Rage
abilities.description: Damage dealt +15%, Haste +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Unbridled Rage is your main burst window (+Physical damage, and it triggers Maximum Carnage's whirl)'. The class's signature enrage. This engine has no enrage STATE, so the three CoA abilities that only exist to keep Smash castable are plain buffs and Smash is ungated.

abilities.name: Defiance
abilities.description: Damage taken -30% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Defiance (damage taken cut 30-80% the lower your health)'. A buff's stat_mods are read raw by take_damage's taken_mult, so damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION here. The health-scaled 30-to-80% band has no hook on a cast buff, so it lands at the floor, 30%; the scaling half is covered by Blood and Glory's low_health_damage_reduction_pct in the Brutality tree.

abilities.name: Jawbreaker
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 1 turn.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Jawbreaker - interrupting them and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 4 seconds'. This engine has ONE crowd-control category, is_stun - status_effects.py says so outright ('one mechanic, is_stun, with no separate silence/root category') and StatusEffectMixin.is_stunned is what actually withholds a turn. So the interrupt is is_stun for one turn, which this ability already carries. School lockout has no hook. DEAD FLAG REMOVED 2026-10-29: stat_mods carried {'silenced': 1}, described here as 'the shipped convention's tooltip label'. Nothing reads it, and a stat_mod shaped exactly like the mechanism it is not IS the is_aoe trap - which is why tools/validate_class.py now ERRORS on stunned/silenced/rooted/stealthed rather than warning. It was removed from the emitted JSON earlier the same day and not ported here, so re-running this script silently restored it.

abilities.name: Headhunter's Spear
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target. Generates 25 Energy.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Headhunter's Spear ... restores 30% of your maximum Energy'. The `generates` field is how a builder pays in one currency and produces another, so the refund is real rather than flavour. ranged_damage - it is thrown, and Barbarian's weapon map includes thrown/gun/crossbow.

abilities.name: Maiming Spear
abilities.description: Thrown at the legs. They can still come for you, just slowly.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Throw your ranged weapon at your enemy's legs ... slowing their movement speed by -50%'. There is no movement in a turn fight, and a haste debuff would have been worse than nothing: a Monster reads ONLY `armor` and `attack_power` out of a status effect's stat_mods (entities/monster.py), so haste on an enemy is inert. A hobbled enemy hitting softer is what actually lands.

abilities.name: Skull Smash
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 1 turn.
abilities._source: CoA: 'hurl it at an enemy's skull, disorienting them ... Damage taken will end this effect'. Disorient is modelled as the engine's stun, which is the closest honest fit; the break-on-damage half has no hook, so the duration is one turn to keep it from being strictly better than CoA's. DEAD FLAG REMOVED 2026-10-29: stat_mods carried {'stunned': 1}, which is read by nothing - the real mechanism is the is_stun flag this ability already sets. tools/validate_class.py now errors on it. Removed from the emitted JSON earlier the same day and not ported here, so re-running this script restored it.

abilities.name: Ancestral Roar
abilities.description: Heals you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Ancestral Roar - Requires Enraged. Roar with ancestral fervor, healing you for AP'. Enrage gate dropped (no enrage state); the AP scaling is covered by the engine's own healing_power contribution rather than a literal AP coefficient.

abilities.name: Warband
abilities.description: Heals your party over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Bring all nearby allies into the warband for 12 seconds, granting them Born in Blood, repeating every 3 sec' - and the spec pages are blunt that this 'is a regen buff, not triage. It cannot heal a dungeon.' A party HoT needs target_type='party'; buff_scope only chooses between turn-based and wall-clock duration and would have left this self-only.

abilities.name: Thick Skull
abilities.description: Immune to crowd control for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'immune to all stun effects for 10 seconds ... Usable while stunned'. The usable-while-stunned half has no hook. The on-damage Born in Blood grant is carried by the Brutality tree's Savagery node instead.

abilities.name: Hodir's Wrath
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to up to 5 targets. Generates 40 Energy.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Erupt with the power of Hodir, dealing AP Frost damage to nearby enemies and restoring 100% of your maximum Energy'. A full refund would make it free, so the generate is 40. spell_damage with damage_school='frost' because effect_type='damage' is hardcoded physical - see the module docstring on where a non-caster's Frost scaling comes from.

abilities.name: Smash
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Smash, your biggest no-cooldown Energy dump, requires an active [enrage]'. No cooldown, so no cooldown here either; the enrage requirement is dropped with the rest of the enrage state.

abilities.name: Brutal Swing
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Brutal Swing is your off-global cleave dump between specials', 'swing violently at an enemy and up to 2 nearby enemies'. off-global = is_instant, the engine's turn-based translation of a free action, same as Warrior's Cleave.

abilities.name: Decapitate
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Decapitate to execute once the target is below 35% HP (each point of spare Energy adds damage)'. THE GATE IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. execute_threshold_pct exists and is PERCENT POINTS (warrior_execute 20, cultist_netherstrike 35), but its check in Ability.use reads `target.current_health / target.health` and Monster has no `health` - it uses `max_health`, while only Character has `health`. getattr(target, 'health', 0) is therefore 0 against every creature in the game, the percentage defaults to 100, and the cast is refused. Every execute-gated ability shipped today (Warrior's Execute, Cultist's Netherstrike, Primalist's Raptor Talons and Bring Me Their Bones, Stormbringer's Electrocute) is uncastable against a monster for that reason. Authoring the gate here would have bought a dead signature ability, so Decapitate is an ungated finisher instead - a longer cooldown and lower damage than a gated execute would carry, since it can be pressed at any health. The spend-spare-Energy scaling has no hook either. Worth fixing in the engine: one getattr.

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 4 targets and stuns them.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Crush is a frontal-cone knockdown and stun', 'Landing Crush on a full clump as the tank gathers - that is the biggest AoE payoff the spec has'.

abilities.name: Onslaught
abilities.description: Restores energy to you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Onslaught is an Energy battery that floods the bar for execute phases'. 45% of the pool, carried on the rank key that effect_type='restore_resource' actually reads - see restore(). It is also an enrage in CoA; nothing here can carry that.

abilities.name: Battle Vigor
abilities.description: Maximum health +15%, Attack Power +30 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Battle Vigor is a +max-health defensive that still counts as an enrage, so it keeps Smash live'. max_health_pct is a FRACTION in the shared bonus pool - health * (1.0 + value) - not percent points.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Killing Spree to charge back in after a kill blow', 'Can only be used within 6 seconds of scoring a killing blow or applying Born in Blood'. There is no recent-kill window to gate a cast on, so it is a plain cooldown and the gate is dropped.

abilities.name: Storm of Steel
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Storm of Steel on a tough single target for sustained ramp', 'striking your target every 1 sec for 80% Weapon Damage for 3 seconds'. A repeating strike over three turns is a dot; effect_value is the TOTAL across the duration, which is how every shipped dot authors it.

abilities.name: Throw Weapon
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'filler Throw Weapon/Berserker Axe'. The spec's cheap ranged filler and the hub of its whole kit - Spear Thrower resets Spears off it, Gurubashi Technique transforms it, Sen'jin's Guidance replaces it.

abilities.name: Barbed Spear
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Barbed Spear to feed Furious Berserker's Born in Blood', 'reducing their healing received by -30%'. The anti-heal debuff cannot ride along: one cast is one effect_type here, and Monster reads only armor and attack_power out of a debuff's stat_mods anyway, so healing_taken_pct on an enemy would do nothing. Damage only, and the crit that feeds Furious Berserker is the part the rotation actually asks for.

abilities.name: Gutspiller
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Launch a heavy axe at an enemy, causing them to bleed for 96 damage over 12 seconds. Every 6 sec the target has their Guts Spilled'. The nested Guts Spilled tick is folded into the one dot and Payback scales it.

abilities.name: Berserker Rush
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Berserker Rush's charge-root-then-leap-back', 'rooting them for 2 seconds, then leap backwards'. Root and reposition are both movement, which a turn fight has none of. The Born in Blood grant it carries in CoA is the Vengeance For Zul'jin talent, which is in the tree.

abilities.name: Berserker Axe
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'weave Berserker Axe while Enraged', 'Hurl two axes at an enemy ... reducing enemy armor by 80'. Enrage gate and the 3-charge recharge model both dropped; a short cooldown is the engine's version of charges. The armour shred is carried by the tree's To The Bone instead, where it can be a real debuff.

abilities.name: Impaling Spear
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 4 targets over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Impaling Spear is a frontal-line bleed via Spear Shards', 'Hurl a spear in a 30 yd frontal line ... At the spear's impact location the spear shatters'. The line and the shatter collapse into one capped AoE bleed.

abilities.name: Savage Revelry
abilities.description: Heals you. Generates 20 Energy.
abilities._source: CoA: "Savage Revelry's health-and-Energy restore is your only quick button". Both halves are real here - the heal through effect_type, the Energy through `generates`.

abilities.name: Axe Twirling
abilities.description: Damage dealt +20%, Physical crit chance +8 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Axe Twirling is your burst button, an Enrage that makes Throw Weapon, Gutspiller and Berserker Axe strike additional nearby enemies'. A buff cannot retarget another ability's cleave, so the window is a damage window; the cleave half is already in the kit as Brutal Swing and Barbaric Whirl.

abilities.name: Javelin Toss
abilities.description: Taken slowly, aimed properly, thrown once.
abilities._source: CoA: "Open at range with Javelin Toss/Throw Weapon", and Sen'jin's Guidance 'Transforms your Throw Weapon into Javelin Toss'. A transform has no hook, so it is its own later, bigger thrown attack and the talent buffs it.

abilities.name: Spite
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Spite bursts and flings you a long way', 'Quickly unleash 3 Berserker Throws at your target and then fling yourself back'. Three throws resolve as one hit; the reposition is dropped.

abilities.name: Keg Smash
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 5 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Keg Smash on cooldown (boosted by Trip to the Alehouse) as your core AoE/ST frost+physical hit'. Kept physical (effect_type='damage') because it is the one ability this spec presses every turn and should not depend on the Frozen Warlord conversion to function; the Frost half of the kit is Breath of the North and Frozen Tankard.

abilities.name: Ancestral Combat
abilities.description: Haste +12, Frost Resistance +15 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: "Keep Ancestral Combat's self-buff rolling: it gives a chance for bonus Frost main-hand swings". The bonus swing is a real 25% bonus_pct proc on the buff itself - extra damage on the same hit, which is what an extra main-hand attack buys. The Fill Level it also generates has no pool to go into.

abilities.name: Ancestral Fury
abilities.description: Grants your party: Haste +10.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Ancestral Fury and Frozen Blades stay up passively. Position so the whole group sits in your haste and crit auras.' An always-on aura, so it keeps the default wall-clock buff_scope rather than expiring with the fight.

abilities.name: Breath of the North
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Breath of the North whenever the Tankard is empty', 'dealing AP Frost damage to enemies in a 12 yd cone'. The empty-Tankard gate needs a second resource this class does not have, so it is a plain cooldown.

abilities.name: Frozen Blades
abilities.description: Grants your party: Physical crit chance +5, Frost Resistance +10.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes now grant party and raid members 5% critical strike chance'. The crit-triggered half is flattened into a standing aura, which is how the spec page describes playing it anyway ('stay up passively').

abilities.name: Frozen Tankard
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to the target and stuns it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Frozen Tankard is a thrown Frost stun that flags Frozen', 'Open dangerous pulls with Frozen Tankard to stun'. The Frozen flag that Icebound Ancestry reads off it has no hook, so that node carries flat crit instead.

abilities.name: Ramhorn Rage
abilities.description: Heals your party over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Ramhorn Rage at the start of a hard pull ... Its max-HP regen (extended by your own autoattacks) is the closest thing you have to a group heal'. Max-HP-proportional ticks and autoattack extension both have no hook, so it is a flat party HoT.

abilities.name: Ancestor's Call
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Call an Honored Ancestor to aid you in battle until dismissed that scales with your Agility and attack power ... Whenever you use Barbaric Whirl or Whirling Advance, your Honored Ancestor mimics it.' NOW A REAL HONORED ANCESTOR. This pointed at 'wolf' and summoned a pet named Wolf - the old note called a called spirit beast 'the closest honest reading', which it was while no ancestor template existed. One does now: a spirit warrior with high crit to match the Ancestry tree's own One With The Ancestors. TWO HALVES STILL UNHOOKED. Scaling off the owner's Agility and attack power is impossible by design - Pet._apply_template_stats reads exactly three owner TALENT keys (pet_damage, pet_health, pet_armor) and nothing else, deliberately, so an owner STAT has no route; The Spins and Might of Utgarde scale the pet through those talent keys instead. The mimic mechanic would need a pet to react to its owner's casts, which nothing in the pet system does; Spirit Whirl keeps the flavour as an ability the Ancestor casts itself.

abilities.name: Cheers!
abilities.description: Grants an ally: Damage taken -8%, Stamina +6.
abilities._source: CoA: "Cheers! on the squishiest party member, or the healer. It redirects part of their incoming damage onto yourself and cuts what they take." The redirect has no hook - nothing reroutes damage between combatants - so only the reduction is real, and it is small because of it.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.description: A noise that makes the people beside you faster and the people in front of you slower.
abilities._source: CoA: 'War Cry / Splash Zone at pull start for the party's attack-speed and attack/spell power burst', 'increasing melee and ranged attack speed by 20%, and attack power by 150 of allies'.

abilities.name: Splash Zone
abilities.description: Grants your party: Attack Power +45, Spell Power +45 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Share a drink from your Tankard with all party and raid members, granting 95 increased attack or spell power'. CoA's either/or is both here - there is no 'whichever stat you use' selector, and giving both is closer to the intent than guessing.

abilities.name: Ale of the God-King
abilities.description: Spell Power +50, Frost Resistance +20 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: "Empower your Honored Ancestor's melee attacks to deal additional Frost damage scaling with your attack power", 'Ale of the God-King the instant your Tankard is full'. NOTHING a cast can carry reaches a pet: summon_damage_pct is authored on one shipped ability and read nowhere, and pet_damage/pet_health/pet_armor are read ONLY off the owner's TALENT effects, once, at Pet construction (entities/pet.py). So the Barbarian drinks it himself and his own Frost gets heavier - spell_power is what Breath of the North, Frozen Tankard and Hodir's Wrath read. The pet-facing half lives in the Ancestry tree as The Spins and Might of Utgarde, where pet_damage and pet_health are real. The Tankard gate is gone with the Tankard.

abilities.name: Tavern Brawl!
abilities.description: Grants your party: Haste +30 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: "Tavern Brawl! as the group haste cooldown for burn phases", 'Enrage all nearby allies, increasing their haste by 30%'. The 5-minute exhaustion lockout has no hook; the 15-turn cooldown stands in for it.

abilities.name: Clanlord's Totem
abilities.description: Grants your party: Damage dealt +12%, Frost Resistance +25 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: "Clanlord's Totem dropped at the fight to buff allies standing near it", 'causing allied players ... to deal 35% AP additional damage as Frost'. There is no placed-object system and no 'your allies' damage becomes Frost' hook, so it is a party damage window. Not effect_type='totem_loadout' - that is the Shaman's totem-slot swap, a different mechanic entirely.
